title: Structured history inventory (draft v1, awaiting owner review)
description: Minimum typed history fields for registration and follow-up encounters. Every field is analysis-visible structured history (analysis_visible true), distinct from page notes (S13, analysis_visible false, never model inputs). Values persist with provenance; unknown and not_assessed are distinct from false (no). Undeclared or FR-14-excluded fields fail validation. Draft for owner review; not approved.

Onset within 8 weeks after long-acting injectable withdrawal (tardive window).

excluded_fields.reason: FR-14-excluded medication regimen detail; never collected, never accepted, even if forged.
FR-14-excluded medication status field; catalog availability is not an active/stopped field.
FR-14: medications are bundled demo-catalog references only; no free-text additions.
Untyped history prose is a page note (S13, analysis_visible false), never analysis-visible history.

provenance_contract.per_field: Each stored value carries {source: clinician_entry|copied_baseline, author_id, recorded_at (UTC Z), baseline_encounter_id when copied}.
provenance_contract.unknown_distinct_from_false: unknown means uncertain; not_assessed means skipped; no means explicitly false. None becomes false.
provenance_contract.server_attribution: Strict writes stamp author_id/recorded_at server-side; autosaved PATCH bodies preserve client-supplied provenance verbatim.

reconciliation_contract.rule: Follow-up drafts copy baseline history with source copied_baseline and status pending; the author must explicitly reconcile (pending -> reconciled) with the current revision. Registration drafts are not_required.
reconciliation_contract.phone_update: Optional free-text phone update rides with history for follow-up (no country validation, like S06 phone). It is analysis_visible false (identifier, never a model input) and does not affect history completeness.

analysis_visible_label.history: analysis_visible true: typed history values are the only history source for estimation context, prompts, CPTs, DDI, and proposal selection.
analysis_visible_label.notes: analysis_visible false: page notes (S13) never influence applicability, projections, inference, prompts, CPTs, DDI, or selection; enforced by serialization allowlists.

completeness.rule: Complete when every field id holds a permitted value (yes/no/unknown/not_assessed or its enum). Missing field ids are missing_item_ids; undeclared ids are item_errors; excluded ids are rejected. Null scores do not apply to history; completeness is the result.

source.note: Minimum inventory derived from the four adverse-effect criteria documents plus owner-permitted exposure/duration/trial-adequacy/prior-response/monitoring categories (2026-10-04 Q/A). Concrete thresholds require owner review; none invented here.

assumptions: Twelve fields are the minimum covering F1-F4 context plus R7/F5 trial-adequacy/prior-response review; additions arrive as versioned changes.
Tri-state plus not_assessed (yes/no/unknown/not_assessed) keeps uncertain and skipped distinct from false.
source_gaps: Concrete trial-adequacy thresholds and no-improvement percent-change cutoffs are not defined here (S37 owns the no-improvement definition).
Observation windows for established-case review (R7) require owner approval of the concrete inventory.

release.severity_mapping: History carries no severity; severity lives on the four effects under reviewed definitions.
